title: Scene placement rulebook

rules.rule: Make the actionable edge match gameplay geometry.
rules.numbers: no number found
rules.pass_fail: Overlay collision/area debug view on the primary indicator at cast, impact and expiry; flag mismatches separately from decorative overflow.

rules.rule: Assign importance separately for each viewer role.
rules.numbers: 1–10 is reported League practice; exact scale singly sourced.
rules.pass_fail: Record caster/enemy/ally priorities and the decision each visible cue supports.

rules.rule: Let the current actionable threat beat irrelevant spectacle.
rules.numbers: no number found
rules.pass_fail: Ask testers what they must react to while reward, ambient and ally effects run; record wrong-target reactions.

rules.rule: Keep a recognisable primary shape across variants.
rules.numbers: no number found
rules.pass_fail: Blind-test ability identity for base/skin/recolour variants; reject a variant that changes the inferred action.

rules.rule: Make projectile direction readable when paused.
rules.numbers: no number found
rules.pass_fail: Pause at several positions and ask travel direction; inspect head–tail ambiguity.

rules.rule: Remove irrelevant viewer-specific cues.
rules.numbers: no number found
rules.pass_fail: For each layer, document whose next action would change if it vanished; omit only genuinely noninformative variants.

rules.rule: Reserve value and saturation headroom across the whole scene.
rules.numbers: no number found for universal brightness ratios or HSV bands.
rules.pass_fail: Inspect scene/character/VFX/UI simultaneously; identify unintended competitors at the moment of decision.

rules.rule: Use the stage to support the effect.
rules.numbers: no number found
rules.pass_fail: Replay on brightest, darkest and most patterned permitted surfaces; adjust the background or effect contrast if recognition fails.

rules.rule: Move ornament away from gameplay sightlines where possible.
rules.numbers: VALORANT reports most details above player height; no universal pixel-height rule.
rules.pass_fail: Check expected target/path screen regions under the actual camera; reduce decorative contrast in those regions.

rules.rule: Budget overlap by decision performance, not emitter count alone.
rules.numbers: no number found for universal count, coverage or overdraw threshold.
rules.pass_fail: Run worst credible multiplayer overlaps on target phones; measure detection errors, response time, screen occlusion and GPU cost together.

rules.rule: Retire active hazard language when the hazard ends.
rules.numbers: no number found
rules.pass_fail: Stop on the final damage/status tick and inspect the remaining border/colour/motion; residue must not imply another hit.

rules.rule: Lower the prominence of aftermath.
rules.numbers: no number found
rules.pass_fail: Compare peak and residue under competing threats; flag residual smoke/light that attracts attention away from a new actionable cue.

rules.rule: Check effects while the player is looking elsewhere.
rules.numbers: no number found
rules.pass_fail: Use a central tracking task plus peripheral warning; repeat at actual phone display size and camera distance.

rules.rule: Treat surprise onsets as a shared scene resource.
rules.numbers: no number found for a safe onset interval.
rules.pass_fail: Compare isolated and rapid overlapping bursts while targets move; record missed warnings and tracking loss.

rules.rule: Do not assume the brightest pixel wins.
rules.numbers: no number found
rules.pass_fail: Use eye tracking when available, otherwise timed recognition/choice tests; compare intended focus with observed choices.

rules.rule: Keep hit confirmation semantically distinct from firing.
rules.numbers: VALORANT example 80 ms plus processing from 40 ms one-way; not a Roblox budget.
rules.pass_fail: Test misses, predicted hits rejected by server, late confirmations and moving/crouching targets.

rules.rule: Check screen effects with player control active.
rules.numbers: no number found for universal shake amplitude, frequency or duration.
rules.pass_fail: Test aim, camera turn, jump/path navigation during kick/shake/zoom; retest with reduced effects.

rules.rule: Match the timing style to the gameplay contract.
rules.numbers: no number found
rules.pass_fail: Log cast/contact/peak/last-active/last-visible timestamps in milliseconds; do not add cosmetic delay to a required instant response.

rules.rule: Build temporal contrast at scene level.
rules.numbers: no number found
rules.pass_fail: Compare ordinary play, buildup, payoff and aftermath; check that ordinary repeats have not consumed every available prominence cue.

rules.rule: Keep depth cues useful.
rules.numbers: no number found
rules.pass_fail: Review foreground particles, camera-near cards, fog and depth of field; confirm all required target/path cues remain available.

rules.rule: Test the composition with optional polish removed.
rules.numbers: no number found
rules.pass_fail: Disable bloom/world light/camera layers and inspect whether identity, hit extent and phase remain understandable.

rules.rule: Do not import film staging as a compulsory gameplay cut.
rules.numbers: no number found
rules.pass_fail: For a cinematic payoff, verify whether control and threats are intentionally paused; otherwise keep the gameplay view usable.

rules.rule: Calibrate screen measurements before interpreting them.
rules.numbers: duration_ms=1000×frames/fps; arithmetic conversion, not a tuning recommendation.
rules.pass_fail: Record viewport resolution, device, camera FOV/distance, capture frame rate and display frame rate beside every coverage or timing measurement.

rules.rule: Use a single problem statement for each review change.
rules.numbers: no number found
rules.pass_fail: Record moment, viewer, symptom, probable cause, exact parameter edit, protected gameplay meaning and a comparison test.

rules.rule: Check that observers can distinguish an attempted action, successful hit, blocked hit and completed outcome with the selected effect build.
rules.numbers: no universal threshold found
rules.pass_fail: Fail when a miss reads as success or a success cue is hidden by the preceding action.

rules.rule: Randomise only decorative dimensions whose variation cannot change the meaning or timing of a gameplay cue.
rules.numbers: No supported universal rotation, hue, size, timing-jitter range or variant count found.
rules.pass_fail: Hold collision boundary, contact cue, team identity and warning deadline invariant.

rules.rule: Stress-test the repeated event at the game’s actual maximum cadence and realistic multiplayer concurrency.
rules.numbers: Use the brief’s 1,000-event replay as an automated durability workload, not a clinically safe human exposure prescription.
rules.pass_fail: Fail if tails accumulate, UI stops being readable, the next contact is masked, or frame-time budget fails.

rules.rule: Keep cheap input confirmation available when decorative repetition is capped or suppressed.
rules.numbers: No universal cooldown, cap or ducking percentage found.
rules.pass_fail: Fail if an accepted action becomes indistinguishable from dropped input.

rules.rule: Tie combo escalation to a readable change in achieved outcome, then test bounded progression against constant feedback.
rules.numbers: No sourced step count, escalation increment, reset time or maximum intensity found.
rules.pass_fail: Fail if spectacle makes separate hits or the streak-reset state ambiguous; do not assume more streak juice raises retention.

rules.rule: Author one contact event that schedules the visual punch and sound transient together; measure actual output synchrony.
rules.numbers: No universal allowable game-impact delay found. Schedule from the same event, then measure displayed and audible output; no numerical offset default is prescribed.
rules.pass_fail: Check audio waveform onset against first visible contact/flash in captured output, including device latency and dropped frames.

rules.rule: Separate an intentional distant-explosion delay or anticipation sound from an accidental sync error.
rules.numbers: No universal sound-leading or picture-leading offset for hits found.
rules.pass_fail: The event card explicitly identifies the causal sync point and whether a nonzero offset is artistic/physical.

rules.rule: Assess the composite scene, including overlapping emitters, muzzle flashes, lighting, post effects, UI and camera movement.
rules.numbers: Evaluate every rolling 1-second interval; see SA01 criteria below.
rules.pass_fail: Per-asset passes are insufficient when the final combined output can exceed a criterion.

rules.rule: Do not use an accessibility toggle or seizure warning as the only response to known hazardous flashing.
rules.numbers: no number found
rules.pass_fail: Remove or redesign known failures before release; a player may encounter them before reaching settings.

rules.rule: Provide an off setting for nonessential camera shake, bob, motion blur and automatic camera movement.
rules.numbers: Halo Infinite example: separate 0–100% blur, shake, full-screen effect and speed-line controls. This scale specifies controls, not physical safe amplitude.
rules.pass_fail: Minimum setting fully removes the targeted nonessential motion; feedback remains interpretable.

rules.rule: Encode essential team, danger, rarity and state information with a non-colour signifier.
rules.numbers: At least one additional signifier: shape, pattern, icon or label.
rules.pass_fail: Correct interpretation remains possible without distinguishing the assigned hues; test with players, not simulation alone.

rules.rule: Use contrast ratios for important readable UI/markers, not as instructions to intensify every effect.
rules.numbers: XAG 102: standard important text/visual elements 4.5:1; large elements 3:1; high-contrast UI mode 7:1.
rules.pass_fail: Measure against the lowest-contrast local background; a glowing particle core does not certify the whole telegraph.

intro: Use these rules as observable checks. A number describes its stated source context only. When no transferable threshold exists, the pass/fail task replaces an invented screen percentage or particle cap.
